container.definitions: Ordered tendency definitions: constants hold actor/group/value/metric/lookback/prior strength; fields lists the exact remaining field names
container.profiles: Each record retains the full profile identity and state, one local sorted clock table, and an ordered matrix of tendency values
container.clock_columns: Every nonnull field ending _clock is replaced with an exact local clock-table index; null clocks stay null
container.all_other_columns: Raw numerators, denominators, support counts, raw estimates, shrunken estimates and states are retained as exact original JSON values

parity: Canonical sorted-key JSON of every decoded real profile equals its uncompressed original exactly
rights: Schema and fictional examples public; actual player profile packages stay private under the existing guarded allocation
